changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Add table_code column to restaurant_table. Table codes must be unique within a restaurant layout.
changeSet.sql: WITH numbered_tables AS ( SELECT rt.id, 'T' || LPAD(ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY rs.restaurant_layout_id ORDER BY rt.table_order )::text, 3, '0') AS generated_code FROM restaurant_table rt JOIN restaurant_row rr ON rt.restaurant_row_id = rr.id JOIN restaurant_section rs ON rr.restaurant_section_id = rs.id WHERE rt.table_code IS NULL ) UPDATE restaurant_table SET table_code = numbered_tables.generated_code FROM numbered_tables WHERE restaurant_table.id = numbered_tables.id;
